scope: Reject observed incomplete Chief prose for new assignments; safely archive stopped local selections and export owner-bound persisted engineering receipts; verify existing full offline implementation path.
riskAnalysis: Security-sensitive contract/history and owner UI changes. Preserve exact historical requests, original receipts and source identities. New prose screening is partial syntax checking, not semantic acceptance or a provider incomplete-response fix.

threatModel.assets: Historical request and receipt integrity, owner/workspace-scoped evidence, closed authority, review separation and source identity.
threatModel.trustBoundaries: New exact server-owned objective opts into Chief screening. Two authenticated owner readbacks precede local archival. Download is private and bound to the last authenticated snapshot; neither action creates authority.
threatModel.abuseCases: Old approval replay, foreign or active selection archival, lost storage acknowledgment, stale export after owner change, incomplete prose accepted as complete, forged review or publication.
threatModel.mitigations: Frozen five-stage historical fixtures/policies; current-only admission; stable twice-read stopped history and cleanup; append-before-clear exact raw selection archive; snapshot epoch/owner binding; unchanged review/source/token/permission enforcement.

defects.rootCause: Chief scope/exclusion/deliverable fields had length checks but accepted the exact observed unfinished model sentences.
defects.detectionGap: Prior tests covered placeholder/criterion validation but not the actual unfinished list fields. Provider cause and backend truncation remain unproven.
defects.regression: New exact-contract fixtures reject observed fragments and obvious dangling clauses; complete concise statements pass; native controller rejects before Specialist dispatch while recording usage/cleanup.
defects.historicalPrevention: Freeze all five former compact-guidance requests and policies; preserve old assignment parsing/readback while requiring new current policy for fresh tasks.

defects.rootCause: Stopped development sequence selections remained in sessionStorage; exact runtime checks correctly rejected them after a successor release.
defects.detectionGap: Open-sequence recovery required empty local cache; no independently verified archive path existed for a stopped local selection.
defects.regression: Two authenticated stable GETs, closed authority, original raw archive before removal, storage interruption recovery, foreign/active/cache/history/admission rejection tests.
defects.historicalPrevention: Retain stopped server records and exact local selection history. Never relax runtime fences or restore consumed approvals.

defects.rootCause: The legacy download exported only local pilot stream events, yielding an empty file when engineering work used the separate existing controller.
defects.detectionGap: Tests checked stream transport but not a useful private export of persisted engineering workflow receipts.
defects.regression: Separate private owner-bound snapshot export preserves receipt order/hash and failures, omits foreign records, rejects empty/stale owner/source states and makes no extra network request.
defects.historicalPrevention: Label both downloads and last-refresh provenance explicitly; do not represent snapshot checksums as human acceptance or invoice proof.

rollback: Leave paid authority disabled. Revert only this reviewed feature-branch source batch if release qualification fails; preserve previous source/receipts, local archive records, checkpoints and all financial uncertainty. No Production rollback is needed.
